import json, numpy as np

import torch
torch.manual_seed(42)
class Model(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = torch.nn.Embedding(vocab_size, 16)
        self.linear = torch.nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.relu = torch.nn.ReLU()
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.relu(self.linear(self.embedding(x)))
model = Model(len(vocab))

    out = model(torch.tensor(arr[:100], dtype=torch.long))
print('recomputed mean:', float(out.mean()))
print('recomputed std:', float(out.std()))
with open('metrics.json') as f:
    metrics = json.load(f)
print('metrics total_tokens:', metrics['total_tokens'])
EOF
```
